audience: freelancers and consultants who take bookings with SavvyCal scheduling links

useCases.title: List your booked meetings
useCases.text: The AI lists booked events and reads one by id. You get your upcoming meetings with their dates and times.

useCases.title: See the open time slots of a link
useCases.text: The AI reads the available booking slots of a scheduling link, with start, end, duration and rank.

useCases.title: Check which scheduling links you have
useCases.text: The AI lists your scheduling links and reads one by id. You see what is set up.

useCases.title: Make a copy of a scheduling link
useCases.text: The AI creates a copy of an existing scheduling link, so you can start a new link from one that works.

useCases.title: Switch a link between active and disabled
useCases.text: The AI toggles a scheduling link. This changes whether the public booking page accepts bookings.

useCases.title: Cancel a booked meeting
useCases.text: The AI cancels a booked event. This notifies the attendees and frees the slot.
